name: After § 49
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 49a. Expresses serious concern that EU funding for media, journalism, fact-checking and civil-society organisations may create financial dependence on the institutions whose policies and narratives those organisations are expected to scrutinise; stresses that public funding must never be used, directly or indirectly, to build a privileged ecosystem of organisations that amplify institutional policy positions while marginalising, disadvantaging or excluding legitimate critical voices; condemns any practice whereby access to EU funding is influenced by political alignment, editorial orientation or willingness to support particular policy narratives; calls for full transparency of all relevant grants, beneficiaries, subcontractors, selection criteria, evaluation procedures, lobbying and advocacy activities financed with EU funds, and any links between funded organisations and EU institutions; insists on genuine political neutrality, arm’s-length allocation of funding and equal treatment of organisations irrespective of their political, ideological or editorial positions; underlines that the EU cannot credibly defend media pluralism and democratic debate while simultaneously financing actors in a manner that risks rewarding conformity with its own political priorities;
